title: Concept: Yarn lockfile resolves a package from a git remote
description: yarn.lock declares a Yarn resolution that names a git remote instead of a registry range, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The code sits outside the registry's publication controls, so its advisory linkage and provenance are unknown.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: The code sits outside the registry's publication controls, so its advisory linkage and provenance are unknown.
